snippet.title: Anomaly Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Anomaly is a horror game inspired by Scanner Somber and the Garry's Mod game mode, LIDAR. You are placed into a world of pure darkness and the only way to see is with your LiDAR gun. Explore around the environment the find keys to open doors to escape from this nightmare, but watch out... there is something lurking in the darkness ready to strike.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2116460/Anomaly/?beta=0
Discord: https://discord.gg/ZwEn6wVMze
